mechanism: A remote scale view identifies one consequential threshold, a single cut crosses it, and an extended continuous follow converts abstract environment into embodied passage. Moving light, partner or tool coordination and one local material cue interrupt forward motion; the sequence then ends on a clearly visible post-inspection route state without claiming the cue was diagnosed or resolved. Terrain, participants, material cue, route, camera carrier and final route state remain variable.

invariants.rule: Use the opening scale view to identify one precise threshold or route, not merely an attractive landscape.
invariants.purpose: Gives the following interior movement a destination and scale conversion.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a specific threshold, the exterior is disconnected B-roll and the interior cut feels arbitrary.

invariants.rule: Cross the threshold with one decisive edit or occlusion, then preserve spatial continuity long enough to feel embodied travel.
invariants.purpose: Turns environment from illustration into a route the audience can inhabit.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated coverage cuts erase distance, orientation and physical effort.

invariants.rule: Bind participants, lights and tools into a clear coordination pattern whose spacing changes with the route.
invariants.purpose: Supplies readable human-scale motion inside a visually repetitive environment.
invariants.ablation_failure: Independent wandering or identity drift makes the passage feel synthetic and removes practical stakes.

invariants.rule: Interrupt travel with one local material or environmental cue that can be indicated, measured or physically reacted to.
invariants.purpose: Creates a causal observation beat rather than endless forward walking.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a local cue the sequence has atmosphere but no event; an implausible cue destroys documentary credibility.

invariants.rule: After the inspection, end on one clearly visible route state—continue, pause or change direction—without claiming a diagnosis or hazard response unless directly shown.
invariants.purpose: Gives the passage a readable post-inspection endpoint while preserving uncertainty.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending before the route state is visible makes the inspection feel truncated; asserting an unshown diagnosis turns observation into fiction.

slots.name: threshold_environment
slots.constraint: A specific opening, hatch, canopy, chamber or access point with visible scale context.

slots.name: field_team
slots.constraint: One to three original humans, animals or machines with stable roles and silhouettes.

slots.name: route_geometry
slots.constraint: A continuous, physically traversable path with stable orientation anchors.

slots.name: reveal_light
slots.constraint: Headlamp, UV beam, lantern, reflected daylight or moving shadow that reveals material layers.

slots.name: local_cue
slots.constraint: One plausible airflow, vibration, moisture, sound, particulate or structural change.

slots.name: inspection_action
slots.constraint: A gesture or tool action that directs attention to the cue without relying on text.

slots.name: post_inspection_route_state
slots.constraint: A visible continuation, pause or direction change after inspection; causation or diagnosis is optional and must not be attributed to the source unless shown.

slots.name: camera_carrier
slots.constraint: Aerial, cable, body, rover or handheld path suited to the new environment.

anti_copy_exclusions: glacier valley, blue ice cave, black oval aperture and translucent cyan tunnel
two glaciologists, orange and blue-yellow suits, helmets, crampons, backpacks and ice axes
the exact three-second aerial push followed by the same high front-left-to-rear follow route
source prompt's under-ice water, seasonal melting, marking and retreat scenario

instantiations.concept: A forest botanist and a compact quadruped rover enter an exposed-root sinkhole; a cable-cam threshold view gives way to one low interior follow, the rover's silk airflow ribbon snaps toward a side fissure, the botanist marks the observation, and both continue along the already established main root corridor.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Temperate-forest field documentary with root-sinkhole scale, human-rover coordination, an inspected airflow cue and a visible continuation state.

instantiations.concept: A harbor engineer and a floating sensor puck enter a tidal service tunnel at low water; continuous waist-level following reveals a reversing foam line, the engineer tests it with dye-free cork chips, logs the observation with one physical marker, then continues along the same raised catwalk.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Tidal infrastructure inspection using seawall threshold, human-sensor coordination, a current cue and a visible post-inspection continuation.

instantiations.concept: A theatre rigger and a ceiling crawler robot pass through a stage-grid hatch; one continuous beam-lit walk exposes a cable strand vibrating out of phase, the rigger tags the location without diagnosing it, and both continue along the established truss path.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Backstage height inspection with hatch threshold, tool-light reveal, a tagged vibration cue and visible continued travel.

failure_modes.failure: The opening landscape has no relationship to the interior route.
failure_modes.repair: Make the threshold visibly identifiable in the exterior and match its orientation at the cut.

failure_modes.failure: The continuous follow is only forward walking.
failure_modes.repair: Use changing participant spacing, moving reveal light and one local cue that visibly interrupts attention or pace.

failure_modes.failure: The environment looks like glass or fantasy material.
failure_modes.repair: Specify weight, deposits, moisture, abrasion, sound and tool interaction native to the new material.

failure_modes.failure: The transfer is only the same two explorers in a different cave.
failure_modes.repair: Change team topology, environment class, tool relationship, cue physics, camera carrier and post-inspection route state together.
